description: Pinned repositories for measuring Ratchet's precision and recall. Changing a commit changes the measurement; say why in the commit message.

repositories.name: paramiko
repositories.why: SSH: RSA, ECDSA, ECDH, Ed25519, X25519, and hand-rolled DH

repositories.name: pyjwt
repositories.why: JWT signing over cryptography: RSA, ECDSA, Ed25519, HMAC

repositories.name: python-jose
repositories.why: JOSE with several interchangeable backends (cryptography, pycryptodome, python-rsa, ecdsa)

repositories.name: certbot
repositories.why: ACME client: key generation, CSRs, certificates

repositories.name: twisted
repositories.why: Conch SSH implementation and TLS glue; large, older codebase

repositories.name: django
repositories.why: Web framework: non-security MD5/SHA-1 uses next to password hashing

repositories.name: scapy
repositories.why: Packet library with a TLS stack and legacy ciphers

repositories.name: ansible
repositories.why: Large automation codebase; incidental hashing

repositories.name: golang-jwt
repositories.why: JWT signing: RSA, RSA-PSS, ECDSA, Ed25519

repositories.name: x-crypto
repositories.why: Go's extended crypto: SSH, ACME, legacy algorithms; dense and adversarial

repositories.name: go-jose
repositories.why: JOSE: RSA-OAEP, ECDH-ES, ECDSA, Ed25519

repositories.name: step-ca
repositories.why: Certificate authority: key generation and signing

repositories.name: cfssl
repositories.why: PKI toolkit; vendored dependencies

repositories.name: age
repositories.why: Modern file encryption: X25519 and a post-quantum hybrid recipient

repositories.name: caddy
repositories.why: Web server with automatic TLS

repositories.name: vault
repositories.why: Secrets manager: transit engine, PKI; very large

repositories.name: java-jwt
repositories.why: JWT for Java: RSA and ECDSA through JCA. Not scanned until Java support

repositories.name: jjwt
repositories.why: JWT for Java: JCA algorithm strings. Not scanned until Java support

repositories.name: node-jsonwebtoken
repositories.why: JWT for Node: algorithm names as strings. Not scanned until JavaScript support

repositories.name: forge
repositories.why: Pure-JavaScript crypto: RSA, DES, RC2, MD5, implemented by hand. Not scanned until JavaScript support
